mentions.description: This tool lets users search, filter, and chat with Hacker News "What are you working on?" posts, and includes a visual map (UMAP) that clusters similar posts together to help find specific things or better understand themes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://nthesis.ai/public/hn-working-on

A tool for searching, filtering and chatting with the "What are you working on?" posts. Also has a visual map (UMAP) that clusters similar things together. Useful if you want to find specific things or better understand themes.
